title: Ice, Pillows, and Orders  (冰块、枕头和命令)

segments.t: 十分钟后的咖啡馆角落，欧文拿了两个软枕头垫在泰莎脚下，汉娜递给她一个写字夹板和一支铅笔。先完整听一遍吧。
Two firm pillows under your heel, Tessa, and strict orders not to touch the floor.
Fine, fine. If I cannot stand at the stove, listen carefully to my kitchen rules!
Clipboard ready, Chef Tessa! Who gets the six o'clock bread dough?
Owen has strong shoulders: he kneads the morning dough while I watch the timer.
Deal! I used to help my grandmother knead Sunday loaves every week.
And who whisks the lemon curd and chops carrots for the lentil soup?
You whisk the lemons at my elbow, Hannah, and Caleb chops every vegetable to the millimeter!
Believe me, Caleb will measure every carrot cube with a ruler!
What job do we give Arthur so he feels helpful without breaking anything?
Polishing the twelve white cups at the table, far away from switches and paint!
Now drink this chamomile tea and go rest upstairs, Tessa.
Wake me at six sharp: nobody touches my oven without me in that chair!
现在，让我们一句一句来回味这段温馨的病号指挥。
Two firm pillows under your heel, Tessa, and strict orders not to touch the floor.
「脚跟下垫两个硬实的枕头，泰莎，还有严格的命令：不许脚沾地。」 要用不定式表达禁止或否定，not 永远是紧挨在 to 的前面：
not to touch the floor
千万不要把 not 放在 to 的后面。
Fine, fine. If I cannot stand at the stove, listen carefully to my kitchen rules!
「行，行。如果我不能站在炉子前面，那就仔细听好我的厨房规矩！」 开头连续两个 Fine 表示无可奈何的妥协，而表示仔细听什么东西时，
listen carefully to
后面必须要加上介词 to 才能引出听的内容。
Clipboard ready, Chef Tessa! Who gets the six o'clock bread dough?
「写字板准备好了，泰莎主厨！谁负责早上六点的面团？」 在团队分配任务时，万能动词 get 在这里派上了大用场：
Who gets
其实就是问：这个岗位或者活儿归谁？顺便注意 dough 这个词里 gh 是不发音的（/doʊ/）。
Owen has strong shoulders: he kneads the morning dough while I watch the timer.
「欧文肩膀很结实：他负责揉早上的面团，我来盯着计时器。」 烘焙词汇里又出现了一个不发音的字母：揉面的动词 knead 开头的 k 是不发音的，
he kneads the morning dough
听起来和需要 needs 完全一样！
Deal! I used to help my grandmother knead Sunday loaves every week.
「成交！我以前每星期都帮我祖母揉周日的长条面包。」 只用一个词就热情地达成了协议：
Deal
随后用 used to help 勾起了一段温馨的童年回忆。
And who whisks the lemon curd and chops carrots for the lentil soup?
「那谁来搅拌柠檬凝乳，谁来切扁豆汤里的胡萝卜呢？」 在厨房英语里，打蛋器 whisk 经常直接用作动词，意思是“搅拌”或“打发”：
whisks the lemon curd
而 chops 则指的是在案板上用刀利落地“切碎”。
You whisk the lemons at my elbow, Hannah, and Caleb chops every vegetable to the millimeter!
「你就在我旁边搅拌柠檬，汉娜，让凯勒布把每样蔬菜都切到毫米级别！」 想要形容在旁边紧挨着别人干活，英语有个很生动的说法
at my elbow
字面意思是“在我的手肘边”，而 to the millimeter 则完美对应了我们的“精确到毫米”。
Believe me, Caleb will measure every carrot cube with a ruler!
「相信我，凯勒布会用尺子去量每一个胡萝卜丁的！」 带着几分善意调侃自己的建筑师弟弟，欧文用
Believe me
开头，并且提醒大家，用来测量的尺子是 ruler，而规则是 rule。
What job do we give Arthur so he feels helpful without breaking anything?
「我们给阿瑟安排点什么活，好让他觉得自己帮上忙了又不会弄坏东西？」 在已经有否定意味的 without 后面，英语为了避免双重否定，不会用 nothing 而是用
without breaking anything
表示“不弄坏任何东西”。
Polishing the twelve white cups at the table, far away from switches and paint!
「在桌子那儿擦亮十二个白杯子，离开关和油漆远远的！」 温柔地拿老板阿瑟之前的两次小事故开玩笑：
far away from switches and paint
用 far away from 把老板安全地隔离在危险之外。
Now drink this chamomile tea and go rest upstairs, Tessa.
「现在把这杯洋甘菊茶喝了，上楼去休息吧，泰莎。」 在日常英语里，任何草本植物泡的水都可以叫做 tea：
chamomile tea
注意 chamomile 这个源自希腊语的词里的 ch 要发 /k/ 的音，和 chord 一样。
Wake me at six sharp: nobody touches my oven without me in that chair!
「六点整叫醒我：只要我没坐在这张椅子上，谁都不许碰我的烤箱！」 放在具体时间点的后面，
at six sharp
意思就是“准点”、“一分不差”！现在，用自然语速把整个场景再听一遍吧。
Two firm pillows under your heel, Tessa, and strict orders not to touch the floor.
Fine, fine. If I cannot stand at the stove, listen carefully to my kitchen rules!
Clipboard ready, Chef Tessa! Who gets the six o'clock bread dough?
Owen has strong shoulders: he kneads the morning dough while I watch the timer.
Deal! I used to help my grandmother knead Sunday loaves every week.
And who whisks the lemon curd and chops carrots for the lentil soup?
You whisk the lemons at my elbow, Hannah, and Caleb chops every vegetable to the millimeter!
Believe me, Caleb will measure every carrot cube with a ruler!
What job do we give Arthur so he feels helpful without breaking anything?
Polishing the twelve white cups at the table, far away from switches and paint!
Now drink this chamomile tea and go rest upstairs, Tessa.
Wake me at six sharp: nobody touches my oven without me in that chair!
把脚高高垫在枕头上，主厨泰莎把周三早上的每一个厨房岗位都安排得明明白白，甚至细化到最后一根胡萝卜！这是第4集的倒数第二个场景——一起来听听吧。
Good night!
